status: Exploratory extension fixed before fitting the background interactions; outcomes and descriptive counts have already been inspected. Not preregistration.
purpose: Determine whether existing background questions supply a robust substantive contribution; do not select a model to obtain significance.
primary_modifier: ever paid for a health app: Q10 codes 1 or 2 versus never code 3; codes 4 and 5 retained as an unknown group with separate alternative intercepts
secondary_modifier: weekly application use: Q9 code 4 versus codes 1 through 3; code 5 retained as unknown with separate alternative intercepts
populations: 300 records with other original export source labels, as sensitivity only
source_handling: All records retained in the pooled analysis; source indicator enters A/B intercepts. Researcher reports platform-recruited humans. Original export labels preserved.
forms: linear fee and sharing main effects
interaction_scope: Modifier interacts with all five baseline choice coefficients in the linear model or both alternative intercepts and all seven active cell coefficients in the free-cell model; version intercept effects remain common. Unknown groups have their own A/B intercepts.
primary_contrast: modifier difference in model-adjusted G2 minus G1 utility at CNY89; utility scale assumptions remain explicit
supplement: Linear-model money-ratio contrast between modifier groups with delta-method uncertainty; not a population monetary valuation or pure control effect
validation: Source and version adjusted baseline versus modifier model on identical whole-record five-fold partitions. No use of full-sample initialization in heldout fits.
random_intercept_follow_up: Primary ever-paid modifier with free cells, in both populations, using the same whole-record panel likelihood and 61 versus 161 node checks.
multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the ten reported primary utility-modifier tests (two modifiers, two forms, two populations, plus two primary free-cell random-intercept fits); all are exploratory.
interpretation: Payment/use history is self-reported, self-selected and not randomized; income/demographics are unavailable. Q11 post-choice priority remains descriptive. Interaction or predictive fit alone does not establish novelty.
